test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: What is the function of ducts in Central Industrial Air Conditioning System?

options.text: Located in the liquid line to prevent moisture and dust particles in Air Conditioning System
Collect liquid refrigerant coming from condenser and supply to the expansion valve
Used to carry air from one place to another place
Reducing the pressure and amount of liquid refrigerant into the evaporator

solution:
The correct answer is __Used to carry air from one place to another place**(Option 3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ducts__ are integral to central industrial air conditioning systems.
 
• They are designed to transport air effectively and efficiently within the system.
 
• Air ducts serve the primary purpose of delivering conditioned air to different spaces.
 
• They help maintain uniform temperature and quality in the designated areas.
 
• Properly installed ducts ensure optimized airflow and system performance.
 
• Using high-quality materials and insulation for ducts prevents energy loss and enhances efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Moisture and Dust Prevention:**

 
 
• Some components like filters or dryers are placed in air conditioning systems to prevent moisture and dust.
 
 
 
• **Condenser and Liquid Refrigerant:**
 
 
• The condenser transfers heat from the refrigerant, which then moves to the expansion valve.
 
 
 
• **Pressure Reduction:**
 
 
• Expansion valves are used for reducing pressure and controlling the flow of refrigerant into the evaporator.
